name: 19233-prefillheavy-8bw8a8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 8000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 19233. 1024 is the engine's own `max-num-seqs`; at 1100 tokens per request the KV pool admits only ~400 of them, so ~600 are always waiting and each step fills toward the 16384-token budget rather than running half-empty.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 1000 prompt tokens in and 100 output tokens out per request (min == max == mean on both), no prefix bucket, nothing shared between requests. The backend renders the prompt through the checkpoint's chat template, which adds 35 tokens, so the client reports 1035 prompt tokens rather than 1000; that is not drift.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter document summarizer condensing thousand-token passages into short briefs for a thousand concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-quantized.w8a8
max-model-len: 32768
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Written out rather than inherited: at this commit `arg_utils.py` picks 16384/1024, 8192/1024
# or 2048 depending on the build context, so pinning both fixes the operating point.
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Prompts share no prefix; pinned off so every request pays its own full 1000-token prefill.
enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-chunked-prefill: true
